text:
Marta: short review request 1 I've trimmed the Connectivity step to a single-pane layout for the Private setup wizard. figma: /designs/onprem/compact-connectivity-v1. Need quick UX + a11y + privacy reads before i handoff.
Leo: skimmed. The compact pane is promising. We should surface two clear actions: 'Quick check' and 'Deep trace' with time estimates. Put the human-friendly reason above the status.
Ben: small policy ask: show the bundle TTL (how long support keeps diagnostics) in the consent modal. customers ask that a lot. e.g., 'Support keeps diagnostics for 30 days'.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) status must be text + icon (no color-only); 2) aria-live region role="status" for probe summary; 3) collapsible tech details have aria-expanded state and keyboard focus.
Marta: copy candidates for hero: A) "Checking outbound access to Redwood (this won't change your network)." B) "Verifying your instance can reach Redwood endpoints. No changes will be made." which is clearer?
Leo: prefer B 1 it's slightly more specific. also add a tooltip: 'Why check? -> ensures model downloads & health reporting'. keep tooltip inline, not modal.
infra-bot: auto-probe 2060001250 result=BLOCKED target=api.redwood.internal:443 probe=tcp timeout_ms=4500 hops=3
Ben: on blocked state, show a one-line actionable step: 'Try opening outbound port 443 or whitelist api.redwood.internal'. Don't show low-level traces first.
Marta: for technical audience we keep a collapsed 'Technical details' with monospace output and a Copy button. expand label: 'Show raw probe output (for support)'.
privacy-bot: recommended defaults: analytics = summarized hop counts + error codes; support bundle = hashed hostnames + summarized hops; full IP lists only with explicit opt-in. Also include an explicit line: 'No credentials or auth headers will be included.'
Marta: Ben raised bundle TTL. propose line in modal: 'Support retains anonymized diagnostics for 30 days.' thoughts?
Ben: yes please. also add a checkbox 'Include full traceroute (may contain IPs)'. default unchecked.
Leo: UX microcopy for consent CTA: 'Share anonymized diagnostics with Redwood Support (no secrets)'. confirmation modal shows a short bulleted list of included fields and the TTL. include a link to the privacy policy.
a11y-bot: extra: modal must trap focus, restore focus on close, and confirm button should be labelled 'Confirm: share anonymized diagnostics'. success toast should be announced (aria-live polite).
Marta: progress interaction idea: an inline stage bar: 'probing -> analyzing -> summary' with small accessible labels at each stage. on quick check show optimistic toast 'Quick check usually < 20s'.
infra-bot: note: quick_check telemetry flag=true for fast endpoint.
Support-bot: template suggestion for support tickets: attach probe summary, OS, installer version, and note whether user included full traceroute. redact per privacy rules.
Leo: mobile: collapse actions into a column, make Copy and Download full width. consent modal full-screen on phones.
Marta: acceptance for eng: 1) implement quick vs deep probe endpoints with telemetry flagging; 2) plain-language reason up top; 3) collapsed technical details with Copy + Download; 4) consent modal listing fields + TTL + redaction toggles; 5) aria-live region + focus management for modal; 6) default telemetry summarized-only.
Ben: i'll draft the TTL/legal blurb for the modal and share.
Marta: i'll update figma with the B copy and add the tooltip + stage bar. please ping me for final copy. target dev handoff tomorrow afternoon. :white_check_mark:
